Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1437
Claimant:
Nancy Holt
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2023-07-24
The insured's policy was reviewed and the driver listed on it is the same person who reported the collision while
turning left at an intersection. Coverage was active at the time of loss, and nothing in the file points to damage
predating the policy start.
2023-07-26
Police confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene and recorded the impact as a left-turn collision.
Respondnig officers noted the vehicle positions matched the reported sequence.
2023-08-04
Scene photographs were obtained from the insured and show damage that is largely consistent with the described
impact. No independent witnesses have come forward, so the photos are the main visual record of the event.
2023-09-15
The claimant, now represented by counsel, reported a concussion following the crash. The injury descriebd fits the
kind and force of a side impact of this type.
2023-11-08
Medical records show the claimant was treated in the usual manner for this kind of head injury. No prior injury to the
same body area appears in the records reviewed.
2023-11-27
The claimant gave the same account of the collision in every conversation so far, including the initial report and later
calls with the adjuster. The sequence of events has not shifted between contacts.
2023-12-06
Vehicle inspection found no sign of earlier damage to the vehicle, and the repair estimate lines up with the reported
impact. The file contains no evidence of prior collisions involving this vehicle.
2023-12-11
Treatment noets show the claimant's symptoms eased steadily over several weeks and the frequency of visits
tapered as recovery progressed. The clinical course is consistent with a typical recovery.
2024-01-13
Counsel has requested an update on the bodily injury claim and was told the file is under active review. No additional
documents were submitted with the request.
2024-02-14
Based on the policy confirmation, police report, photographs, medical records and vehicle inspection, the file is being
handled as a standard left-turn collision claim. Next step is to finalize the injury evaluatoin with counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
